edge_explainer: RE-COURT of the 2026-08-03 batch court (REJECT 3/10) after Novo released Q2 a day early on 08-04, beat, RAISED FY26 guidance - and fell 6.31% to $44.12. Read from primary: Company Announcement No 47/2026 (SEC 6-K accession 0001171843-26-005184) and the 37-page No 48/2026 full H1 report (GlobeNewswire-hosted, not yet on EDGAR), plus buyback 6-K 0001171843-26-005172. THE RAISE: FY26 adjusted sales AND operating profit growth both moved from -4%/-12% to 0%/-6% at CER - a real 6-point raise OF A NEGATIVE RANGE. Q2 adjusted sales +7% CER (DKK 78,488m), adjusted op profit +11% CER (DKK 33,389m); but H1 adjusted was only +2% CER (DKK 148,551m), and REPORTED Q2 operating profit FELL 16% CER (DKK 27,061m) on a DKK 6,328m non-cash pipeline impairment (monlunabant DKK 4.0bn named; ~DKK 2.3bn unnamed). THE DECISIVE ARITHMETIC: with FY25 adjusted base DKK 306,415m split 49.7/50.3 across halves and H1'26 at +2% CER, the RAISED band still requires H2'26 adjusted CER of -2.0% (high end) to -13.9% (low end), midpoint -7.9% - a 9-to-21-point deceleration from the quarter just printed. The prior court asked whether the low end implied an H2 collapse; the answer is yes, and now the high end does too. PRIOR COURT'S TOP UNVERIFIABLE RESOLVED EXACTLY: the 340B rebate-provision reversal is disclosed at DKK 26,760m (USD 4.2bn), non-cash, all in Q1'26 (Q2'25 comparative DKK 2,649m; NO 340B adjustment in Q2'26 at all) - our independent pre-disclosure triangulation (Q1 reported op profit 59,618 less the prior court's adjusted 32,858) gave DKK 26,760m, an exact match. WHAT THE HEADLINE HID: Wegovy INJECTABLE grew only +1% CER - all obesity growth is the new oral product sold at $149-299/month self-pay, cannibalising a far higher-priced injectable; US Operations FELL 4% CER in H1 while International carried the company (+10% Q2, +8% H1, EUCAN +17%/+20%); and Novo's obesity care +16% CER came against a branded-obesity MARKET growing 81% in volume globally / 87% US (IQVIA MAT May-26, company-cited) - share loss plus price, together. THE TERMINAL, DATED AND SIZED: effective 2027-01-01 WAC falls to USD 675 on Wegovy 2.4/7.2mg and tablets to 25mg and on Ozempic 0.5/1/2mg and Ozempic pill 7/14mg - ~50% cut on Wegovy, ~35% on Ozempic - which the company says 'is expected to impact Novo Nordisk's cash flow in 2027'; SCOTUS denied cert 18 May 2026 on Novo's IRA challenge, closing that avenue. Three pipeline hits in five days: ZEUS (NCT05021835, Ph3, COMPLETED, primary completion 2026-06-09) missed MACE on 07-31 with a FURTHER impairment pre-flagged for Q3'26; the DKK 6.3bn Q2 impairment; and REIMAGINE 4, CagriSema head-to-head vs tirzepatide 15mg, DID NOT MEET HbA1c non-inferiority and trailed numerically on weight (15.2% vs 15.8%; 1.9pp vs 2.2pp at 68 weeks) five months before its Q4'26 US decision. TAPE DECOMPOSITION of the -6% (IBKR 15-min bars, conid 10611): flat 47.3-47.7 all session with NO pre-release ramp or dump, then in the SINGLE 16:30-16:45 UTC bar (12:30-12:45 ET, containing the 12:33/12:37 ET GlobeNewswire timestamps) open 47.46 -> high 49.15 -> low 44.93 on 7,555,888 shares, a +$1.69 spike and a -$4.22 collapse in fifteen minutes on a 20-50x volume burst, then a grind to the 43.68 session low. Candidate (c) call-content is RULED OUT BY CONSTRUCTION - the call is 08-05 13:00 CEST and had not occurred; (d) mechanical distribution REFUTED - one information bar, not a day-long drift; (a) the early release is a credibility item only (tagged MAR Article 17 inside information, issued mid-US-session AFTER the Copenhagen close, no reason stated) but was NOT the cause since the first move on it was UP. (b) GUIDE QUALITY is the cause: algos read 'raises outlook', humans read the table. WINNER-PATTERN TEST: FAILS - a mix illusion, not a divergence. FY26 REPORTED estimates rise on a DKK 26.8bn non-recurring reversal (H1 reported EPS/ADR already DKK 15.66, +25%) while H2'26 and FY27 UNDERLYING estimates fall; the raise backfills H1 already banked while guiding the back half negative; the multiple sits at a decade low because the TERMINAL is lower, not the year. TWO PRIOR-COURT FACTS REFUTED (the honest correction to our own work): net debt is DKK 86,523m at 30 Jun 2026, DOWN from 95,424m at YE25 - NOT the DKK ~124.8B claimed, an overstatement of ~DKK 38B; and H1'26 free cash flow was POSITIVE DKK 55,297m (+44%), with FY26 FCF guidance RAISED to DKK 45-55bn from 36-46bn and capex down 15% in H1 to DKK 23,986m (FY ~55bn vs 60bn in 2025, 'expected to decline in coming years') - NOT the 'negative TTM FCF on the capacity build' the batch court asserted. The capex peak is PAST; ratings Aa3/AA; equity 37.2% of assets. Mechanism lesson: the prior court computed net debt from a screen-level debt-minus-cash on a stale quarter and read an FCF series whose definition Novo CHANGED effective Q1'26 with comparatives restated - always take net debt and FCF from the company's own stated line in the current report, never from a screen aggregation across a definition change. VALUATION rebuilt at the company-disclosed spot FX of 6.51 DKK/USD (replacing the prior court's 6.43): market cap US$195.8B = DKK ~1,275B, plus net debt 86.5B = EV DKK ~1,361B; FY26 adjusted EBIT at guide translates to DKK 115.2-122.5B (the guide notes DKK runs ~2pp below CER), adjusted EPS DKK 20.1-21.3 = US$3.08-3.28, so 13.5-14.3x (mid 13.9x) and EV/adjusted EBIT 11.1-11.8x, with a 3.9% FCF yield on the raised guidance. A decade low for Novo but still a premium to declining-revenue large-cap pharma at 8-12x. HONESTY READ - the finding that matters, and it is POSITIVE: Novo chose the LESS flattering basis as its headline metric, voluntarily stripping a DKK 26.8bn favourable one-off out of its own growth rates; disclosed the non-adjusted bridge (+5% sales / +12% op profit midpoints) so a reader can size the one-off; named the impaired asset and amount; PRE-ANNOUNCED a further impairment it expects next quarter; disclosed a head-to-head its own drug lost; and disclosed a 2027 price cut against itself. Most issuers would have headlined the +12%. There is NO takeaway-vs-data divergence authored by the company - the divergence was authored by the headline-reading algorithms. NVO is CLEAN and actively anti-masking; under our doctrine a clean issuer disclosing a hard set-up is a REJECT on price, never a fraud flag. MICROSTRUCTURE ENCODING: masking channel = 'a raise of a negative range' (headline true, body worse); signal channel = the guidance table's implied second-half arithmetic plus the reported-vs-adjusted gap; signal-to-price latency ~15 MINUTES. Not tradeable at our speed - catalogue as an algo-bait pattern, not an edge. CATALYST-BINDING (the AVIR lesson applied): the prior court leaned on CagriSema as a near-term +/-10% driver without binding it; registry verification splits it - REDEFINE 3 (NCT05669755, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING) has primary completion 2027-09-01 and CANNOT read out inside a 12-month hold, while the real near-term event is a Q4'26 US regulatory decision whose value is already impaired by REIMAGINE 4. Binding to the specific trial changed both the date and the sign. NEW LITIGATION SURFACE not previously in our file: Novo SUED Eli Lilly for false advertising (D.N.J., 21 Jul 2026); Cipla ANDA Paragraph IV on Ozempic; and a Sandoz UPC revocation action (30 Jun 2026) against the semaglutide 1mg unitary patent in 18 EU countries - a direct threat to the EUCAN engine now carrying the company. TOP REMAINING UNVERIFIABLE: Novo's own US GLP-1 market share vs Eli Lilly - the report gives only IQVIA MARKET growth and an unnumbered claim to lead 'by new patient starts'; our share-loss inference is derived from Novo's growth vs market growth, not disclosed. Also unquantified anywhere: the NET realisation impact of the 2027 WAC cut (a ~50% list cut paired with reduced rebates can be far less severe on net price) - the largest single uncertainty in the valuation, and it cuts both ways. Compounding is not mentioned anywhere in the report, leaving the queue brief's compounder threat neither confirmed nor refuted.
